phase_synthesis.codex_0139_implication: Use direct web-search and richer schema compatibility as planning inputs, not as permission expansion.
phase_synthesis.codex_app_26608_implication: Use plugin and settings improvements to reduce manual friction, not to mutate account settings without exact approval.
phase_synthesis.mcp_implication: Treat read-only annotations as useful hints but not proof of safety; keep receipts and guards authoritative.
phase_synthesis.owasp_implication: Keep agents least-privileged, observable, separable by route family, and reversible through exact receipts.
